scope: Five named accessory/configuration BASIC forms; configuration menus/options are not additional language definitions. Kill Editor belongs to its separate Appendix B definition.
notes: Ask Editor is labelled instruction, with statement signatures, despite returning editor parameters. It retains command scope rather than being inferred as an expression function.
Call Editor and Ask Editor show function-only and three-parameter statements. Function IDs and parameter meanings are not validated here.
Set Editor in the error catalogue conflicts with the Set Accessory definition. No Set Editor alias is added.
Native accessory eligibility, editor communication, Workbench/editor window state, memory savings and runtime compatibility remain unqualified.
